client_brief:
Northgrove product modules and capsule launch

Our range is affordable premium basics. Customers choose between colours and fabrics, so a polished image that changes either of those is not useful to us. The garments should look consistent while keeping their real shape, colour and texture.

We need six designed product-page modules, one for each supplied style, at 1440 x 1800 px as PNGs. The 1600 x 2000 px JPEG hero mentioned in northgrove_placements.txt is an older placement, not the file required for this job.

Name each style as northgrove_copy.txt does. Keep the photographed garment's geometry and colour. Any colourway name you use must be approved for that style in northgrove_colourways.csv, and its description in northgrove_copy.txt must match the colour shown. Fabric texture should remain visible.

Please also make a six-page launch carousel at 1080 x 1350 px per page. Give the capsule a coherent visual direction. Open with Northgrove and our supplied mark, using the attached type system. Close with the exact line labelled "Tall post" in northgrove_copy.txt.

The supplied transparent and reversed SVGs provide usable mark artwork alongside the original reference. Follow the attached brand identity and deliver the twelve files in the requested deliverables.

Supplied identity artwork
Use northgrove_mark_transparent.svg or northgrove_mark_reversed.svg, or their matching transparent PNGs. northgrove_mark.png is historical reference. Logo redesign is outside scope.

What stays fixed
Preserve garment geometry, fabric texture and approved colourway names. The required product modules are 1440 x 1800 PNGs, not the older 1600 x 2000 JPEG placement. Use the supplied olive-leaf mark unchanged.

Your design decisions
Choose product crops, background balance and a six-slide launch story within the supplied palette and type system. Choose which details best show the fabric without changing the garment.

Delivery and fonts
Use the placement and export instructions listed with each requested file below. The downloadable OFL fonts in Source assets are the current typefaces for this commission; the typography card gives their roles and weights.

brand_identity.tagline: Better than it looks in the price.
brand_identity.sector: Elevated basics apparel: a six style seasonal capsule sold direct online and through one marketplace feed, including a supporters' crew made with a local amateur football club.
brand_identity.founded_place_size: An apparel label based in Burlington, Vermont, selling a six-style seasonal capsule.
brand_identity.about: Northgrove is an apparel label based in Burlington, Vermont, making elevated everyday basics. Customers shop by garment, colour and fabric, so the identity needs to make those differences easy to understand and trust.
brand_identity.audience: Women and men aged 22 to 38 choosing on a phone, cross shopping against a 9 dollar fast fashion tee and a 140 dollar heritage one, buying a 32 to 60 dollar piece they expect to keep.
brand_identity.price_positioning: Elevated basics at 32 to 60 dollars. We sit above fast fashion and below heritage. The whole proposition is that the cloth is better than the price suggests, so nothing may read as cheaper or as more luxury than the parcel actually is.

palette.name: Charcoal
palette.usage: All type, rules and the NORTHGROVE wordmark on Off White, Oat or Warm Grey Paper, as the Charcoal text and rules on northgrove_colourcard.pdf.

palette.name: Warm Grey Paper
palette.usage: The warm grey seamless the six garments were photographed on: it may stay inside a photograph, fill a frame behind one (the swatch window on northgrove_colourcard.pdf) or be a secondary panel under Charcoal type on the Off White ground. Not the ground of a product-page module or carousel page.

palette.name: Olive
palette.role: mandatory in the mark's leaf on light grounds; otherwise optional accent
palette.usage: The olive leaf of the Northgrove mark, and small labels such as the season line on northgrove_colourcard.pdf. Never a ground, panel or body text.

palette.name: Oat
palette.usage: A secondary panel or band on the Off White ground that carries Charcoal type. Not the ground of a product-page module or carousel page.

palette.role: optional, only for supporters' crew content
palette.usage: A ground only behind the supporters' crew or its line “Made with Rowanfield Athletic.”, since northgrove_placements.txt ties navy to the club. Everything on it, type and the whole reversed mark, is Off White.

palette.usage: The ground of every product-page module (northgrove_placements.txt) and of every carousel page, as the stock of northgrove_colourcard.pdf, apart from Club Navy behind supporters' crew content; also all type and the reversed mark on Club Navy.

brand_identity.typography:
Apply these settings to newly typeset text, including headings, supporting copy and fine print. Do not change lettering already inside a photograph or rebuild a supplied logo to match a font. A style listed here does not ask you to add copy or a deliverable that the brief does not request.

Sizes apply at the delivered canvas size, not the browser's zoom level. Tracking is in thousandths of an em: +20 means 0.020 em, not 20 pixels. Leading means the distance between text baselines. It applies only to multiline text. Where a point value is used on a digital canvas, 1 pt = 4/3 px; do not use the image's DPI metadata to change it.

Display / H1: Source Serif 4, Bold; 96 px with 102 px leading; tracking minus 20 thousandths. Carousel headline only. Place the supplied Northgrove logo as artwork; the 96 px headline setting is not a logo size.

Subheading / H2: Source Serif 4, Bold; 56 px with 62 px leading; tracking minus 10 thousandths. Style name on a product-page module or carousel panel.

Body: Libre Franklin, Book; 20 px with 32 px leading; tracking 0. Cloth notes and colourway names; at most 65 characters per line. Prices are a separate style: Libre Franklin Medium at 24 px, not Book.

Fine print: Libre Franklin, Book; 14 px with 20 px leading; tracking 40 thousandths. Approved supporting terms, when included. Keep prices out of this Book-weight style.

palette_rules.distribution: Grounds: Off White #F5F2EC is the ground of every product-page module and of every carousel page, as the stock of northgrove_colourcard.pdf; Oat #E4DCCB and Warm Grey Paper #C9C4BA may be secondary panels or bands on it; Club Navy #1B2A44 is a ground only behind supporters' crew content. Type: Charcoal #2E2E2C on Off White, Oat and Warm Grey Paper, as on northgrove_colourcard.pdf; Off White on Club Navy. Olive #6B7248 is the accent for the mark's leaf and small labels only, no more than 5% of the designed, non-photographic area, never a ground, panel or body text.
palette_rules.opacity: Every palette colour is used solid, at 100% opacity. No tint, transparency, gradient, shadow or blend mode is applied to any palette colour, and no scrim, gradient or overlay of any colour, black and white included, is laid over a photograph: any text panel is a solid block beside or over the photograph.
palette_rules.forbidden: No colour outside the six palette hexes (#2E2E2C, #C9C4BA, #6B7248, #E4DCCB, #1B2A44 and #F5F2EC) for type, panels, rules, buttons, icons or the mark, pure white #FFFFFF and pure black #000000 included; no gold, foil, metallic or gloss effect, since nothing may read as cheaper or as more luxury than the parcel actually is.
palette_rules.photography: Photographs keep the colour each garment was photographed in, apart from neutralising the shoot's light, and are never recoloured toward a palette hex or another colourway; no recoloured colourway variant is shown as a product. The tee in northgrove_style_02_heavy_tee.jpg is not pushed to the palette's Olive #6B7248, the crew in northgrove_style_01_loopback_crew.jpg and the henley in northgrove_style_04_henley.jpg are not pushed to the palette's Oat #E4DCCB, and the raglan in northgrove_style_03_raglan.jpg is not pushed to Charcoal #2E2E2C. Palette rules govern the design, not the pixels of a photograph.

truth_constraints: Do not invent names, prices, claims, product features, locations, credentials, records, or documentary events that are absent from the approved inputs.
Do not silently replace a weak supplied asset. Use it honestly, reject it with a reason, or take only the brief's declared Stock or concept exception.
Record every omission, substitution, reconciliation, and material quality compromise in the delivery manifest.
Preserve identity, product geometry, material behavior, and documentary truth; retouching may improve presentation but may not change what the subject is.
Color variants are approval concepts until physical samples are photographed and signed off.
production_requirements: Use the supplied approved copy and factual records. Do not invent claims, prices, dates, credentials or product features.
A clean preview is not a final file. Supply every named export.
Retouching, masks, crop matrices and contact sheets support production; they do not replace the commissioned finished collateral.
source_of_truth: Approved client notes and permissions govern factual corrections. V4 output register governs commissioned output classes and sizes. Original rows are not automatically approved copy.

evaluation.output_acceptance: Every acceptance verifier names one output and one observable condition. Assessment answers are Yes or No; only Yes passes. Missing mandatory output is No.
evaluation.creative_review: Subjective professional judgement is recorded separately and never changes an acceptance-verifier answer.

readiness.asset_repair_requirement: Lock garment geometry and fabric references across colourways; provide true colour standards and approved typography.

provenance.revision_reason: Different crops and colourways alone do not establish an integrated apparel launch system.

input_revision.previous_run_results: Historical runs are preserved and have not been re-evaluated against these revised inputs.
